title: Waymo gradually resumes freeway routes, starting with Phoenix, more than two months after suspending them to improve performance around construction zones (Kirsten Korosec/TechCrunch)
summary: Kirsten Korosec / TechCrunch: Waymo gradually resumes freeway routes, starting with Phoenix, more than two months after suspending them to improve performance around construction zones — Waymo is slowly adding freeway routes back to its service area more than two months after the company stopped driving these high-speed roads …
